sql: CREATE TABLE catalogue_entries (generation INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogue_generations(generation), connection TEXT NOT NULL, library TEXT NOT NULL, library_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, authors TEXT NOT NULL, has_ebook INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(has_ebook IN (0,1)), has_audio INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(has_audio IN (0,1)), classification TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(classification IN ('none','singular-supported','needs-attention')), file_identity TEXT, service_path TEXT, format TEXT, mount TEXT, source_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_fingerprint)=64 AND source_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), PRIMARY KEY(generation, connection, library, item_id))

CREATE TABLE catalogue_generations (generation INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(fingerprint)=64), current INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(current IN (0,1)), CHECK(current = 0 OR generation > 0))
CREATE TABLE catalogue_schema (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (version = 'catalogue-v2'))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalogue_one_current ON catalogue_generations(current) WHERE current = 1
